recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. Any future split of the Search page into multiple pages should be handled as separate editorial/work-group design work; the current source now satisfies the FHIR-32852 ToC and heading-structure request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core request to fix the Search page structure, including incorrect heading levels, misplaced sections such as composite search parameters, capitalization/indentation cleanup, and a coherent top-level ToC for the long Search page.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-32852-tagged implementation commit was found. The issue appears to have been substantially applied by Gino Canessa's untagged January 2022 Search page restructuring, especially commit 83529ed121dc9fc1d9aeb117b0fe8a6293f9f0c9, which replaced the old top Summary Table with Contents and reorganized the Search page headings.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-01-24 record the accepted disposition as creating a Table of Content for the page with a 15-0-0 Persuasive vote. Current source/search.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and already has the intended Contents structure, but the Contents entry for Paging and Other Resources linked to #paging while the section only exposed legacy #Paging.
reconciliation: Added a lowercase immediately after the existing anchor before the Paging and Other Resources heading, preserving existing uppercase-fragment compatibility while making the current Contents link resolve.
source_changes: source/search.html: added a lowercase paging anchor before the Paging and Other Resources heading so the top Contents link to #paging has a matching target while the existing #Paging anchor remains available.
